relationships.subject: FLS-derived exosomes
relationships.evidence_quote: These results indicated that miR-146a-FLS-Exos could inhibit chondrocyte apoptosis to a certain extent in vivo

relationships.subject: FLS-derived exosomes
relationships.evidence_quote: These results indicate that FLS-Exos overexpressing miR-146a can effectively induce the polarization of synovial macrophages from the M1 phenotype to the M2 phenotype

key_findings: miR-146a targets TRAF6 and suppresses TLR4/TRAF6/NF-κB signaling in chondrocytes and OA cartilage.
miR-146a-overexpressing FLS exosomes reduced cartilage injury, synovial proliferation and shifted macrophages from M1 to M2 in OA rats.
